provenance.note: This JSON summarizes results already executed and observed. It is not a reconstructed raw pytest log. No tests were rerun to produce this summary.
provenance.timestamp_note: The tool output did not include a wall-clock timestamp; recorded_at_utc is the summary creation time, not an invented execution timestamp.

warning: StarletteDeprecationWarning: Using httpx with starlette.testclient is deprecated; install httpx2 instead.
detour_coverage: Future-only route replacement preserves the travelled path and current human/dog positions.
obstacle_bypass, legacy obstacle_clear, and resume retain the fixed obstacle and start the detour.
Repeated bypass requests do not append geometry or resume an unrelated pause.
A pending duplicate obstacle is idempotent; a second obstacle is rejected until the person has cleared the detour.
Pause, disconnection, and same-session reconnect preserve the chosen navigation; reconnect does not resume automatically.
Cancel preserves path, progress, and fixed obstacles; reset clears obstacles and rearms the automatic event.
Separate visitors and old snapshots do not share mutable route or obstacle state.
Insufficient straight room near a corner or destination rejects placement without changing the route.
Both blocked sides reject placement; one blocked side selects the clear alternative.
Thin collision footprints are detected between sampled curve vertices.
Delivered city detours at 0m and 32m clear all 159 static proxies and the board footprint.
Dog and person centres travelling on the same arc, 2.2m apart, retain at least 0.65m clearance from the board.
Completion clamps to the extended route length and uses updated step distances/instructions.
Text bypass and refresh expose the authoritative new path.
Explicit pause words in 暂停绕行 and 绕行时停一下 take precedence over bypass.

verified_geometry.clearance_note: 0.65m is the asserted lower bound, not a reported exact minimum. Static clearance is checked against all proxy polygon edges. Human/dog board clearance is sampled at 301 progress positions for each tested detour.

real_tcp_blackhole.method: Independent localhost TCP proxy discards bytes in both directions without injecting FIN/RST. Normal Uvicorn transport settings remain enabled.

scope_limits: This is backend automated-test evidence, not browser visual, physical-phone, robot, LAN, or public-network acceptance.
The real 151.1078m live route check is tracked separately by the parent agent.

sha256_snapshot.note: Current file hashes captured when recording this summary after the test run; the execution itself did not emit a hash manifest.
